services.name: Liz Glazer
services.desc: is a standup comedian and former tenured law professor who delivers high-energy, punchline-heavy comedy. A recent winner of both the Boston Comedy Festival and Ladies of Laughter competition, Liz also made her recent debut on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon, Kevin Hart's Funny AF on Netflix, Comics Unleashed on CBS, and has sets online with Don't Tell Comedy, Comedy Underground Overground, and Nate Bargatze's The Showcase. Her full special, Do You Know Who I'm Not? is available on YouTube. Liz's comedy derives from her life as a rabbi's wife, former lawyer, and new mom.
